title: PFO ACCESS Registry
brief_summary: Closure of Patent Foramen Ovale with the AMPLATZER® PFO OCCLUDER in patients with at least two cryptogenic strokes due to presumed paradoxical embolism through a patent foramen ovale and who have failed conventional therapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patent foramen ovale (PFO); recurrent cryptogenic stroke; failed antiplatelet/anticoagulant therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

International normalized ration (INR) outside of 2-3; intracardiac thrombus (subjects may be enrolled after resolution of thrombus)
